description: Audit-only finding: the binding-canonical pipeline does NOT use single-K Plancherel averaging. The original Phase A.1 framing in issue #522 is a misnomer; the canonical pipeline uses the axiomatic Markov trace (M1+M2+M3 recursion via markov_trace_canonical.tr_M_element), not any partition sum. The k_cap = K_PARTITION_MAX = 11 truncation lives in the DEPRECATED Plancherel-weighted code path (hecke_core.atom_markov_trace), which is not on the canonical pipeline's call path.
verdict_detail: The 10^6 ppb gap claimed in workplan A.1 is NOT due to single-K averaging of the Markov trace. The canonical pipeline already routes through the axiomatic recursion. The actual gap likely comes from (a) Phi_q exactness (workplan A.2) or (b) higher tower levels (workplan A.3, separate audit).

modules_audited.method: axiomatic recursion (Markov axioms M1, M2, M3)
modules_audited.note: Top docstring explicitly says: 'Differs from the Plancherel-weighted trace ... used in hecke_core.atom_markov_trace and binding_3A — these do NOT satisfy (M2) with the canonical z and give different values.'

modules_audited.method: calls markov_trace_canonical.tr_M_element on each atom-braid generator
modules_audited.note: Imports tr_M_element from markov_trace_canonical at line 37. No partition argument anywhere.

modules_audited.method: Plancherel-weighted sum Sigma_lambda w_lambda * chi_lambda(W) / d_lambda over partitions filtered by k_cap = K_PARTITION_MAX (= 11)
modules_audited.note: DEPRECATED. Docstring explicitly: 'At q != 1 this is NOT the canonical Jones-Markov trace ... Use markov_trace_canonical.tr_M_element for the canonical axiomatic Markov trace'. The Plancherel form gives ~0.104 at q_0 vs canonical ~0.499 for tr_M(sigma_0) — ~5x error per term.

single_K_site_note: There is no single-K averaging in the canonical pipeline. The k_cap = 11 is a multi-K (multi-jet-depth) cap on the deprecated Plancherel sum. No code in binding_canonical / markov_trace_canonical takes a partition argument.

existing_partition_infrastructure.purpose: Enumerate partitions of n as decreasing tuples
Specht-module dimension f_lambda via classical hook formula

recommended_re_scope.A.1_prime: Audit Phi_q exactness in the binding contribution (workplan A.2 territory) — Phi_q(|tr_M|) may need exact rather than truncated evaluation.
recommended_re_scope.A.1_double_prime: Find any caller in the canonical pipeline that still routes through the deprecated atom_markov_trace (~5x per-term error) and migrate to tr_M_element.
recommended_re_scope.A.3: Mass-tower truncation level N — separate audit (claude/phase-a3-mass-tower-audit branch).
